'''P'Dar'Ken Hall''' was a utilitarian building constructed after the arrival of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]]. [[Colonial Governor]] [[Marsh Limoth]] ordered its construction because he wanted to keep the members of the [[P'Dar'Ken]] separate from the populace. The [[P'Dar'Ken'Al|members]] of the P'Dar'Ken and their families lived and worked within the large building.
